items.name: materialcn-theme
items.title: Material 3 Theme
items.description: The Material 3 Expressive token layer: color roles and four alternate palettes, type scale, shape, spacing, elevation, state layers, motion springs, and the responsive grid. Points shadcn's semantic variables at M3 roles, so stock shadcn components render as Material.

:root.--m3-elevation-1:
0 1px 2px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--m3-shadow) 30%, transparent),
    0 1px 3px 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--m3-shadow) 15%, transparent)
:root.--m3-elevation-2:
0 1px 2px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--m3-shadow) 30%, transparent),
    0 2px 6px 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--m3-shadow) 15%, transparent)
:root.--m3-elevation-3:
0 1px 3px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--m3-shadow) 30%, transparent),
    0 4px 8px 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--m3-shadow) 15%, transparent)
:root.--m3-elevation-4:
0 2px 3px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--m3-shadow) 30%, transparent),
    0 6px 10px 4px color-mix(in oklab, var(--m3-shadow) 15%, transparent)
:root.--m3-elevation-5:
0 4px 4px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--m3-shadow) 30%, transparent),
    0 8px 12px 6px color-mix(in oklab, var(--m3-shadow) 15%, transparent)

@utility m3-circular-progress-indetermin.animation:
m3-circular-progress-rotate 1.4s linear infinite,
    m3-circular-progress-dash 1.4s var(--m3-ease-standard) infinite

items.docs: materialcn's tokens are now in your stylesheet. Roboto Flex is installed but not loaded: add `import "@fontsource-variable/roboto-flex"` to your entry point, or point `--m3-font-plain` and `--m3-font-brand` at a font of your own.
